policy: Reuse existing open geometry first; otherwise batch-author dimension-driven reusable components from manufacturer specifications. Do not individually generate generic tools by default.

office_desk.name: 电动升降工位桌
office_desk.evidence: User confirmed sit/stand desks. E7 manufacturer size reference accepts120–200cm ×60–80cm tabletops and height58–123cm. Chosen140×60cm top and73/110cm review states; not an exact E7 replica or confirmed site brand. Three-stage legs, motors, beam, keypad, cable tray and articulated monitor arm are locally authored. Preview animation uses0.12m/s, not claimed hardware speed.

office_chair.name: 人体工学网椅
office_chair.evidence: User confirmed ergonomic chairs. STYRSPEL published size/adjustability is a reference; site brand is unknown. Local curved open-mesh seat/back, separate headrest, lumbar wings/slider, adjustable arm-pad structure, synchro-tilt housing, gas lift and twin-wheel five-star base. The reference is not a manufacturer CAD or site-product identification. Default independent viewer now uses the generic Hyper3D preview variant; the dimension reference does not identify it as a site product. See the variant manifest for calibrated bounds, source hash and factor-only PBR materials.
